Title: Tanay's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Tanay - 8 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Kavita - 40 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Tanay stands in the park. Kavita stands near him.]

Kavita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Tanay plays cricket in the park.]

Tanay: "Show me too!"

[Tanay plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Tanay: "One more time!"

[Tanay does yoga on a mat.]

Tanay (gently): "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Tanay stands by the road. Kavita stands near him.]

Kavita: "So, here we are!"

[Tanay rides his bicycle down the road.]

Tanay (gently): "What happened?"

[Tanay gets into the car.]

Tanay: "I'm ready!"

[Tanay gets on the bus.]

Kavita (excited): "That's easy."

[Tanay gets off the school bus.]

Tanay: "I knew it!"

[Tanay hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Tanay: "Okay, Mom."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Kavita stands near him.]

Tanay: "What a nice place."

[Tanay jumps with joy.]

Tanay: "What next?"

[Tanay helps Mother get up.]

Tanay: "Oh wow!"

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Tanay (excited): "Really?"

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Kavita: "Really?"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Tanay: "Yes, all right."

[Flower petals rain down on Tanay.]

Kavita: "Well done!"

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Tanay: "What a day to remember!"
